components.text:
The Ritual of the Geode's Bounty grows and harvests crystal clusters (such as amethyst) within its range, similar in spirit to the Demon Will crystal-harvesting rituals but aimed at vanilla geode crystals. Tier 0, costs $(blood)20,000 LP$() to activate.
Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.

Various Demon Will types can be channeled into this ritual via the Aura to change its growth/harvest radius, harm nearby entities, or accelerate growth. Check the ritual's tooltip in-game (via the Ritual Diviner or a Divination Sigil) for the exact current bonuses on this branch.
